item.title: Des Moines County Sheriff’s Deputies were dispatched to 25900 205th Ave. for a burglary discovered
item.description: Des Moines County Sheriff’s Deputies were dispatched to 25900 205th Ave. for a burglary discovered. Deputies observed that forced entry was made to an overhead garage door to a building. It appeared that a vehicle was used to ram the door.
